subject.title: [Bug] Race condition in approval-classifier.ts when tokenization exceeds max tokens

question: Does the reporter have concrete evidence of an executable ACP permission bypass that should be moved to the private security process, or should this remain an unconfirmed public report pending a minimal reproduction?
rationale: The alleged impact is an approval bypass, but the described tokenizer race does not match the inspected current-main permission boundary and exploit details should not be solicited publicly.

options.title: Request private reproduction
options.body: Ask the reporter through the repository security channel for redacted ACP frames, exact version/config, timing, and proof of an unauthorized action.

options.title: Close as unsubstantiated
options.body: Close only if security owners confirm the claimed path cannot exist and no private evidence is available.

recommendation.title: Request private reproduction
recommendation.body: Ask the reporter through the repository security channel for redacted ACP frames, exact version/config, timing, and proof of an unauthorized action.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent semantic ACP approval-class work is the closest historical ownership signal for deciding whether the claim reaches a real permission boundary.
